Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_03038_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_03038_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_03038 (
    input wire                  br_taken,
    input wire [1:0]            src_reg_used,
    input wire                  is_eret,
    input wire                  id_en,
    input wire [4:0]            id_rd_addr,
    input wire                  id_gpr_we_,
    input wire [5:0]            id_mem_op,
    input wire [5:0]            op,
    input wire [4:0]            rs1_addr,
    input wire [4:0]            rs2_addr,
    input wire [4:0]            id_rs1_addr,
    input wire [4:0]            id_rs2_addr,
    input wire                  ex_en,
    input wire [4:0]            ex_rd_addr,
    input wire                  ex_gpr_we_,
    input wire [5:0]            ex_mem_op,
    input wire [31:0]           mem_pc,
    input wire                  mem_en,
    input wire [4:0]            mem_exp_code,
    input wire [31:0]           mepc_i,
    output reg [31:0]           mepc_o,
    output reg [4:0]            exp_code,
    output reg                  save_exp,
    output reg                  restore_exp,
    output wire                 if_stall,
    output wire                 id_stall,
    output wire                 ex_stall,
    output wire                 mem_stall,
    output wire                 if_flush,
    output wire                 id_flush,
    output wire                 ex_flush,
    output wire                 mem_flush,
    output reg [31:0]           new_pc,
    output reg [1:0]            rs1_fwd_ctrl,
    output reg [1:0]            rs2_fwd_ctrl,
    output reg                  ex_rs1_fwd_en,
    output reg                  ex_rs2_fwd_en,
    input wire                  ic_busy,
    input wire                  dc_busy,
    input wire [3:0]            issue_id,
    input wire [3:0]            if_hart_id,
    input wire [3:0]            id_hart_id,
    input wire [3:0]            ex_hart_id,
    input wire                  hart_ic_stall,
    input wire                  hart_dc_stall,
    input wire                  hart_ic_flush,
    input wire                  hart_dc_flush,
    input wire [31:0]           if_pc,
    input wire [31:0]           ex_pc,
    output reg                  cache_miss,
    output reg [3:0]            cm_hart_id,
    output reg [31:0]           cm_addr
);

    reg     ld_hazard;

    wire dc_flush_id;
    wire dc_flush_ex;
    wire dc_flush_mem;
    wire br_flush_id;

    assign if_stall  = ld_hazard | hart_dc_stall | ic_busy | dc_busy;
    assign id_stall  = hart_dc_stall | ic_busy | dc_busy;
    assign ex_stall  = hart_dc_stall | ic_busy | dc_busy;
    assign mem_stall = ic_busy | dc_busy;

    reg    flush, eret_flush;
    assign if_flush  = flush | eret_flush;
    assign id_flush  = flush | ld_hazard | br_flush_id | dc_flush_id;
    assign ex_flush  = flush | dc_flush_ex;
    assign mem_flush = flush | dc_flush_mem | hart_dc_stall;

    assign dc_flush_id  = hart_dc_flush & (ex_hart_id == if_hart_id);
    assign dc_flush_ex  = hart_dc_flush & (ex_hart_id == id_hart_id);
    assign dc_flush_mem = hart_dc_flush;

    always @(*) begin
        cache_miss = 1'b0;
        cm_hart_id = 4'h0;
        cm_addr    = 32'h0;
        if (hart_dc_flush) begin
            cache_miss = 1'b1;
            cm_hart_id = ex_hart_id;
            cm_addr    = ex_pc;
        end else if (hart_ic_flush | hart_ic_stall) begin
            cache_miss = 1'b1;
            cm_hart_id = issue_id;
            cm_addr    = if_pc;
        end
    end

    assign br_flush_id = br_taken & (id_hart_id == if_hart_id);

    always @(*) begin
        if( (id_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (id_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (src_reg_used[0] == 1'b1)     &&
            (rs1_addr        != 5'b0)     &&
            (id_hart_id     == if_hart_id) &&
            (id_rd_addr     == rs1_addr)
        ) begin
            rs1_fwd_ctrl = 2'b01;
        end else if (
            (ex_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (ex_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (src_reg_used[0] == 1'b1)     &&
            (rs1_addr        != 5'b0)     &&
            (ex_hart_id     == if_hart_id) &&
            (ex_rd_addr     == rs1_addr)
        ) begin
            rs1_fwd_ctrl = 2'b10;
        end else begin
            rs1_fwd_ctrl = 2'b00;
        end

        if ((ex_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (ex_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (ex_mem_op[3]    == 1'b1)     &&
            (id_mem_op[3:2]  == 2'b01)    &&
            (id_rs1_addr     != 5'b0)     &&
            (ex_hart_id     == id_hart_id) &&
            (ex_rd_addr     == id_rs1_addr)
        ) begin
            ex_rs1_fwd_en = 1'b1;
        end else begin
            ex_rs1_fwd_en = 1'b0;
        end

        if ((id_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (id_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (src_reg_used[1] == 1'b1)     &&
            (rs2_addr        != 5'b0)     &&
            (id_hart_id     == if_hart_id) &&
            (id_rd_addr     == rs2_addr)
        ) begin
            rs2_fwd_ctrl = 2'b01;
        end else if (
            (ex_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (ex_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (src_reg_used[1] == 1'b1)     &&
            (rs2_addr        != 5'b0)     &&
            (ex_hart_id     == if_hart_id) &&
            (ex_rd_addr     == rs2_addr)
        ) begin
            rs2_fwd_ctrl = 2'b10;
        end else begin
            rs2_fwd_ctrl  = 2'b00;
        end

        if ((ex_en           == 1'b1)  &&
            (ex_gpr_we_      == 1'b0) &&
            (ex_mem_op[3]    == 1'b1)     &&
            (id_mem_op[3:2]  == 2'b01)    &&
            (id_rs2_addr     != 5'b0)     &&
            (ex_hart_id     == id_hart_id) &&
            (ex_rd_addr     == id_rs2_addr)
        ) begin
            ex_rs2_fwd_en = 1'b1;
        end else begin
            ex_rs2_fwd_en = 1'b0;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        if ((id_en        == 1'b1)         &&
            (id_gpr_we_   == 1'b0)        &&
            (if_hart_id   == id_hart_id)      &&
            (id_mem_op[3] == 1'b1)            &&
            (   (op    != 6'b010000) ||
                ( (op  == 6'b010000)  && (id_rd_addr == rs1_addr) )
            )                                 &&
            (   ( (src_reg_used[0] == 1'b1) && (id_rd_addr == rs1_addr) ) ||
                ( (src_reg_used[1] == 1'b1) && (id_rd_addr == rs2_addr) )
            )
        ) begin
            ld_hazard = 1'b1;
        end else begin
            ld_hazard = 1'b0;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        new_pc      = 32'h0;
        flush       = 1'b0;
        save_exp    = 1'b0;
        exp_code    = 5'b00000;
        mepc_o      = 32'h0;
        restore_exp = 1'b0;
        eret_flush  = 1'b0;

        if (mem_en == 1'b1) begin
            if (mem_exp_code != 5'b00000) begin
                new_pc   = 32'h00000010;
                flush    = 1'b1;
                save_exp = 1'b1;
                exp_code = mem_exp_code;
                mepc_o   = mem_pc;
            end else if (is_eret) begin
                new_pc      = mepc_i;
                restore_exp = 1'b1;
                eret_flush  = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_03038.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
